svg.text: Why only the imaginary dial works for every trip length
below 0: the classical path is a MAXIMUM
in that direction (one more per half-period)
Left half-plane is always out: wiggly paths have huge kinetic action.
Past the first caustic the right half is out too. Only Re κ = 0 survives.
At each caustic the imaginary dial picks up a quarter turn e^(−iπ/2) (Maslov).
Morse index theorem (Morse 1934); 'action is not least' (Gray and Taylor 2007). Checks R6–R9. The dial-plane reading is ours.
